question.aiUpdated: Question updated by AI — review and save
question.passageTitlePlaceholder: Passage title, e.g. 1. Read the email and answer the questions.
question.passageShared_one: This passage is shared with {{count}} other question of the same reading. Changes are copied to it when you save.
question.passageShared_other: This passage is shared with {{count}} other questions of the same reading. Changes are copied to them when you save.
question.savedShared_one: Question saved · passage updated in {{count}} other question
question.savedShared_other: Question saved · passage updated in {{count}} other questions

placeholders.dropdown: Type your sentence and insert blanks, e.g. “The sky is [[b1]].”
placeholders.dragdrop: Type your sentence and insert blanks, e.g. “23 × 2 = [[b1]]”
placeholders.labeling: Instructions, e.g. “Label the parts of the plant”

question.explanationPlaceholder: Explain why the answer is correct. Students see this after answering.

problems.emptyOptions: Fill in or delete the empty options
problems.emptyPairs: Complete or delete the empty pairs
problems.dropdownChoices: Every dropdown needs filled options and a correct one
problems.dragdropItems: Every blank needs a correct item
problems.categorize: Name every group and add at least 2 items
problems.hottext: Select the correct parts of the text
problems.matchgrid: Mark the correct column for every row
problems.tablefill: Make at least one cell a blank with an answer
problems.hotspot: Draw at least one correct area
problems.crosswordWords: Add at least 2 words with 2 or more letters
problems.crosswordEmpty: Type the word for every clue or delete the row

demo.hottext: A little boy was <m>watching the red flames</m> in the wide open fireplace…
demo.story: Once upon a time, in a small village…

choice.pollNote: Polls are not graded. Students see how the class voted.

fill.mathNote: Students type with an on-screen math keypad. Supports + − × ÷ ^ √, parentheses, variables and π.

notes.open: Students type a free response. Grade it in the report — manually or with AI using the sample answer.
notes.draw: Students get a drawing canvas (with your question image as background if you add one).
notes.video: Students record a short video with their camera. Review it in the report.
notes.audio: Students record a spoken answer with their microphone. Review it in the report.
notes.wordcloud: Students submit short words or phrases. Responses build a live word cloud.
notes.discussion: Students post ideas to a shared board and can read each other’s posts in real time.

open.sampleAnswer: Sample answer (optional, used for AI grading)

reorder.note: Enter the items in the correct order. Students will see them shuffled.

match.note: Each row is a correct pair. Students see the right column shuffled.

blanks.hint: Blanks appear as <c>[[b1]]</c> in the text.
blanks.needBlank: Insert at least one blank into the question text.

hottext.placeholder: Paste or type the passage students will highlight in…

tablefill.note: Type values in the cells. Click ⬚ to turn a cell into a blank students must fill. Separate alternative answers with |.

image.uploadHint: A diagram, map, photo or chart

labeling.clickToAdd: Click on the image to add a label position.
labeling.label: Label

hotspot.hint: Drag on the image to draw a clickable area. Click an area to toggle correct (<g>green</g>) or distractor (gray).

graphing.hintPoints: Click the grid to place the correct points. Correct answer: {{answer}}
graphing.hintLine: Click the grid to place the correct two points of the line. Correct answer: {{answer}}

crossword.note: Type each answer and its clue. The grid is built automatically; spaces, hyphens and punctuation are ignored.
crossword.empty: Type at least 2 words to see the grid.
